o: Cora, a fugitive turned Blade Runner, partners with Olwen, a dying Replicant, to hunt a runaway in a reborn Los Angeles. Together they uncover a truth threatening to destroy their fragile city.

eps.o: A brutal raid presses Cora to infiltrate the Los Angeles Police Department to retrieve a confiscated item that exposes a buried truth.
Battling to cover up their own secrets, Cora and Olwen partner to hunt a rogue colleague.
Cora risks exposure when her past deceit lands her brother in danger. Olwen's missteps force her to retrace her past with a missing Replicant.
Cora and Olwen track runaways to a Mexico City hideout. As dark ambitions clash with hidden secrets, both women confront painful pasts.
Cora investigates her past while Olwen faces new threats, forcing a dangerous reckoning.
Cora and Olwen forge an uneasy alliance to hunt a lost relic. On Cora's home turf, old ghosts and new dangers close in. Hunted themselves, they must choose: compete or survive together.
Out of time and out of options, Olwen turns to Cora. Their uneasy alliance is tested when the past catches up to their doorstep.
Olwen's final hours meet Cora's desperate bid for legacy. When ambitions collide, no one escapes unchanged.
